claims: Trump Accounts are tax-advantaged, government-backed, child-focused investment accounts authorized by the 2025 "One Big Beautiful Bill Act".
Trump Accounts provide a $1,000 federal seed contribution for children born 2025–2028.
Trump Accounts allow $5,000 in annual contributions.
Funds in Trump Accounts are accessible to the beneficiary at age 18.
Any child under 18 with a Social Security number can have a Trump Account.
A $1,000 one-time tax-exempt pilot program contribution is exclusively for children born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028.
Trump Accounts allow up to $5,000 in annual contributions per child.
Funds in Trump Accounts are invested in broad U.S. stock market index funds.
Funds in Trump Accounts remain under the control of a parent or guardian until the child turns 18.
Parents or guardians can register for Trump Accounts through the official TrumpAccounts.gov site.
Parents or guardians can register for Trump Accounts by filing IRS Form 4547.
IRS Form 4547 is often filed with the 2025 tax return.
Over 5 million children have been signed up for Trump Accounts as of April 2026.
The official launch of Trump Accounts is set for July 4, 2026.
